name: How do I get an estimate for a foreclosed bathroom refresh in Denver, Centennial, or Parker?

mainEntity.name: How do I get an estimate for a foreclosed bathroom refresh in Denver, Centennial, or Parker?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, the most useful first step is a site visit so the contractor can check moisture damage, fixture condition, and whether the project is cosmetic or repair-heavy. That matters because foreclosed homes often hide problems that are not obvious in listing photos.
acceptedAnswer.description: Book an on-site estimate so the contractor can inspect for hidden damage and scope the work correctly. That is the fastest way to know whether your project is a refresh or a larger repair.
